display_name: x402 Exact Solana Payment Outcome Recompute
purpose: Clause-by-clause verdict recompute of an x402 exact-scheme Solana payment from pasted values: the decoded instruction list, the PaymentRequirements, the mint's declared token program and fee configuration, and optional Ed25519 signature checks over caller-pasted bytes. Spec readings are pinned at x402-foundation/x402 (the canonical repo) commit e4a086819f419e9395acbbdc1679fe6627029ff7, specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_svm.md, and reference readings at the same commit's TypeScript facilitator (scheme.ts, smartWalletVerification.ts). Each clause reports what the spec text accepts, what the reference code accepts, and a verdict of PASS, FAIL or DIVERGES where the readings disagree: the amount rule (the spec outcome accepts overpayment while the static path rejects any inequality, scheme.ts L1160), the single-matching-transfer rule, the destination ATA (recomputed under both token programs with the pinned associated-token-account derivation, so a classic-program derivation for a Token-2022 mint is visible as the two addresses differing), fee payer isolation, the net amount on a Token-2022 transfer-fee mint (the static path compares the gross instruction amount while the balance-delta readings compare the net after withheld fees, min(ceil(gross*bps/10000), maximum_fee)), the memo rule and transaction-version admission. Transaction version 1 is spec-defined as of the re-pin (advertised through extra.transactionVersions, integers 0 and 1, default 0, fail closed otherwise), which replaced the earlier spec-undefined stance recorded in the fixture notes. Two Kora advisories name exactly these seams (GHSA-725g-w329-g7qr transfer fee not deducted, GHSA-x442-m7cc-hr92 unrecognized instruction stubs bypassing fee payer policy; severity field medium on both records, no patched version on either) and are cited as facts. Values only, no wording about risk or intent. Zero network, zero RPC, nothing on-chain is read, no facilitator is called, no balance is looked up.

trust_label: deferred: deterministic source published, zkVM proof not yet generated; New gpu:false node built 2026-10-29. String equality and BigInt comparisons over pasted values with vendored SHA-256, vendored Ed25519 point decompression and vendored Ed25519 signature verification (verify path only, on caller-pasted bytes), base58 integer conversion, the fixed 255-iteration canonical-bump scan inside the ATA derivation, and ceiling-division fee arithmetic in BigInt; no hashing inside the kernel beyond the vendored primitive (the artifact execution_hash is computed by the shared _hash.mjs outside it), no transcendentals, no in-guest signature generation. Expected FAST on a GPU static pre-screen. Excluded from section-18 proving until the next batch (SPEC.md section 18).
